about.title: About — Fatumon
about.meta: Who we are, what the platform is built on, what we offer and where we are going.
about.lead: A research team building its own AI for the crypto market — and checking every claim it makes.
about.who.title: Who we are
about.who.p1: We are a research team. The platform is built on three things: our own data collector, several AI models that reason and compute, and our own market history that no open source provides.
about.who.p2.gb: GB of order book, futures and funding data, collected continuously.
about.who.p3: Every claim is checked twice — on history and in a live run with no real money — and the outcome of every signal is recorded in an open journal. The analysis is not numbers alone: news and events that move the market are taken into account too.
about.offer.title: What we offer
about.offer.p1: An ecosystem of apps for traders: signals, a full breakdown of the market and of a specific token — and an explanation of how the system reached that conclusion.
about.offer.p2: Not a ready-made answer but an understanding of the market: every conclusion can be traced back to the data and the rule it was made by.
about.why.title: Why
about.why.p1: The market is full of promises and short on verifiable results. Signals are handed out without a track record, strategies are shown only on their best stretches, and nobody publishes the outcome.
about.why.p2: We do the opposite: an open journal where every signal and its outcome are visible — the good ones and the bad. Trust is built on facts you can check, not on words.
about.where.title: Where we are going
about.where.text: A platform for traders, players and AI agents: journal and signals, token breakdown, a forecasting game, data for machines — and our own market model.
how.title: How it works — Fatumon
how.meta: Data from 8 exchanges, the strategy researcher, the models and a multi-step check: history, live run, journal.
how.lead: Data, the strategy researcher, the models and the verification — everything a signal is made of.
how.data.title: Data
how.data.p1: Order book and trades in real time, futures, open interest, funding, the spot–futures gap, anomalies — from 8 exchanges, continuously, into our own storage. On top of the numbers comes the fundamental side: news and events that move the market.
how.data.why: This data does not exist in any open history. We have it.
how.research.title: Strategy researcher
how.research.p1: The agent takes every available trading strategy from the market's history, formalizes it into testable rules and runs it through a single backtest.
how.research.p2: It then breaks them down into building blocks and assembles its own strategies from them. A strategy that passes every stage of verification goes into the live run and the journal.
how.models.title: Models
how.models.qwen: Qwen — an open language model for data processing.
how.models.rule: The rule makes the decision; the model explains it.
how.check.title: Verification
how.check.lead: No strategy is marked as working until it has passed the whole chain.
how.check.s1.title: History
how.check.s1.text: History is split into three parts: training, validation, quarantine. A strategy sees the quarantine set once — at the very end.
how.check.s2.title: Costs
how.check.s2.text: Fees and slippage are computed from the real order book, not from an average figure.
how.check.s3.title: Overfitting guard
how.check.s3.text: A strategy has to work on data it has never seen. Anything that holds only on a lucky stretch is dropped.
how.check.s4.title: Live run
how.check.s4.text: No real money, on the live market. Every signal is recorded the moment it appears.
how.check.s5.title: Journal
how.check.s5.text: An open journal with the outcome of every signal. What failed stays in it too.
how.check.s6.title: Status: working
how.check.s6.text: Only after both layers — history and the live run. One of them alone does not count.
how.disclaimer: This is a research platform, not financial advice.

journal.title: Signal journal — Fatumon
journal.meta: Open signal journal of strategy S1: every signal is recorded before its outcome and never edited.
journal.lead: Shadow run since 25.10.2026. Every signal is recorded before its outcome and never edited.
journal.rule: S1 warns of a sharp move, not of its direction. A signal counts as accurate if a burst followed within 4 hours: 8% or more in 15 minutes, or 15% or more in an hour — either way.
